content.short: Philidor scores and monitors DeFi vaults and tokenized funds, issuing signed risk decisions.
content.description: Philidor scores and monitors vaults and tokenized funds, mapping what each product depends on and issuing signed risk decisions against a client's own policy. A composite score from zero to ten draws on asset, platform, control and history inputs, then places the product in a Prime, Core or Edge tier. Inputs include audits, code maturity, strategy shape and dependency risk. Coverage spans more than a thousand vaults and 450 assets across twelve chains and thirteen protocol modules, including Aave, Morpho, Compound, Spark, Yearn and Maple. The same scores are available through a dashboard, an API and alerts.
content.meta: Maps what a vault actually depends on underneath and issues signed risk decisions against policy.
